correctness.rationale: For W_n=K1 join C_n (n>=5), graph diameter two. A hub-free set is GP exactly when its cyclic binary rim word avoids 111. Inclusion maximality forces every 1-run to have length 1 or 2, every 0-run length 1 or 2, and a 00-run precisely between two 11-runs; at least three selected rim vertices preclude adding hub. Hub-including maximal GP sets are exactly the n edge-plus-hub triples. The 2x2 transfer matrix indexed by selected-run sizes 1,2 has entries [[u²z,u²z],[u³z²,u³z²+u⁴z²]], determinant det(I-T)=1-zu²-z²u³-z²u⁴+z³u⁶, and rooted cycles are counted by n sum tr(T^t)/t; this proves A_n(z)=nz³-n[u^n]log det(I-T) for every n>=5. Simple b_i<=a_i constraints plus cyclic run counting yield the stated exact minimum/maximum rim subset multiplicities. Reciprocal polynomial substitution x+1/x shows only one expanding root α=1.401268..., four unit roots and one reciprocal, giving A_n(1)=n+α^n+O(1). Independently enumerated every subset of wheels n=5,...,12 using true graph geodesic triples and checked the maximal-set coefficients and extremal counts, not merely the transfer recurrence. Those finite tests support but do not substitute for the all-n run-decomposition proof.
